entities.name: Query bS16 protein
observations: 82 aa protein; exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Vibrio campbellii bS16 reference A7MYV1.
Predicted molecular mass is 9.08 kDa and theoretical pI is 10.35, consistent with a small basic ribosomal protein.
Contains Ribosomal_S16 domain PF00886.25 at positions 8–68 with i-Evalue 3.4e-25.

entities.name: Ribosomal protein bS16
observations: Reviewed bacterial small-subunit ribosomal protein associated with the 30S ribosomal subunit.
Functions as a structural constituent of the ribosome and participates in translation.
Annotated to the cytoplasm and small ribosomal subunit.

entities.name: Bacterial translation
observations: bS16 is annotated to the biological process of translation via its role in the small ribosomal subunit.
